issue: मंडित चहुँककूंभा — not a known word; perhaps चहुँ ककुभा ('the four quarters', ककुभ 'direction'), the light adorning all directions. The book and Drik Panchang both print चहुँककूंभा; web search found no independent readable witness (bharatdiscovery.org could not be read; Bhakti Bharat copies Drik Panchang).
our reading: अपनि अनन्तर ज्योति अखण्डित मंडित चहुँककूंभा (as printed)

issue: अनन्तर — taken in Monier-Williams's sense 'uninterrupted, continuous' (beside अखण्डित); it may stand for अनन्त (endless) or आन्तर (inner).
our reading: your own light, unceasing and unbroken
alternatives: your endless light; your inner light

issue: शोभा लखि न बड़े — read as 'even the great (बड़े) cannot behold its splendour'; perhaps a corruption of शोभा लखि न परे ('its splendour cannot be beheld').
our reading: even the great cannot take in its splendour

issue: सुरगम ध्यान धरे — सुरगम read as सुरगण (the hosts of gods); सरगम (the musical scale) would not take ध्यान धरे.
सेवक जन हृदय पटले मृदुल करन सुमति — loose construction: हृदय पटले 'on the surface of the heart', करन 'who makes', मृदुल qualifying सुमति.
our reading: on the hearts of your servants you bring gentle good sense
alternatives: you make your servants' hearts gentle and give them good sense

issue: सदनसिद्धि — not a known compound; read as सदन + सिद्धि (success in the home); perhaps a corruption of सदा सिद्धि or of a list of siddhis.
